combat-effects-atlas-v551.prompt.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Production-ready transparent combat VFX sprite atlas for a painted 2.5D fantasy/post-apocalyptic climate action RPG called Gouden Horizon.
Primary request: ONE ORIGINAL RGBA PNG atlas, portrait 1024 by 1536 pixels, exactly FOUR equal columns by SIX equal rows, 24 isolated effect sprites. Each cell is 256 by 256 pixels. NO labels, no numbers, no grid lines or frame. Transparent background with genuine alpha, NOT a rendered checkerboard.
Style/medium: Premium hand-painted game VFX with tangible material and volumetric forms, comparable polish to Torchlight 2 and Nine Parchments but wholly original; broad expressive painterly strokes, warm contour highlights, crisply readable asymmetric silhouettes, rich cores and soft controlled alpha edges. Effects recognizable by their physical form, not generic glowing circles. Not flat icons, not vector art, not photorealism.
Composition: Every effect centered within its own cell with at least 32 pixels of fully transparent margin on every side, wide transparent gutters between adjacent sprites. Keep all 24 sprites entirely separate. Same scale and aligned cell centers across the sheet. Columns 1 and 2 are compact elongated flying projectiles pointing RIGHT, with the trail to the LEFT; column 2 is the next animated alternate form of the same projectile. Column 3 is a small explosive contact burst; column 4 is its wider expanding/dissipating contact burst. Impacts are detached effects, never touching projectiles. Impact bursts should be asymmetric branching material sprays and shards with transparent holes, never circular rings, donut discs, glowing flat balls or uniform star badges.
Row 1 (top row): AQUA WATER. Column 1 rightward translucent aqua spear made of a curling water crest and bright white foam, pointed forward splash blade. Column 2 flowing alternate aqua spear shape with a different curled crest and foam tail. Column 3 compact bursting splash, sculpted water lobes and droplets. Column 4 spreading broken splash, thinning curling water ribbons and separated glistening droplets.
Row 2: FIRE. Column 1 orange-red flame cinder, a dark ember body and bright white-hot core, elongated rightward tongue with a smoky curl behind it. Column 2 flickering alternate flame cinder with a different smoke curl. Column 3 compact fiery contact flare with black ember fragments, angular yellow flame tongues and a short dark smoke puff. Column 4 wider dissipating fiery burst with red-orange tongues, embers and torn smoke wisps.
Row 3: ELECTRIC. Column 1 violet electric charge orb, strongly elongated rightward by jagged white-lilac branching lightning and a pointed lightning front, deep purple charge core. Column 2 alternate charge orb with redistributed branching lightning. Column 3 concentrated violet-white contact fork explosion, sharp branching bolts and tiny charged debris. Column 4 expanding broken arcs and fading branching lightning fragments, airy with transparent gaps.
Row 4: ACID. Column 1 viscous luminous green acid projectile blob, irregular stretched tadpole form pointing right, glossy yellow-green wet highlights, trailing separated droplets. Column 2 alternate deformed green blob, changed droplet arrangement. Column 3 compact acid splat of thick green fluid lobes and small droplets. Column 4 outward dissipating splat with thinner stringy tendrils, separated green droplets and a few pale vapor wisps.
Row 5: SOLAR. Column 1 golden solar crystal dagger shooting right, sharp faceted amber-gold blade with etched ray motifs and a short glittering gold tail. Column 2 alternate flying golden crystal dagger with a changing ray glint and tail. Column 3 compact striking impact of angular golden crystal splinters and a tiny sun-white flash. Column 4 larger dissolving crystal shard burst, golden flecks and thin rays with transparent spaces.
Row 6 (bottom): METAL. Column 1 brass shrapnel slug flying right, irregular heavy metal projectile with bevels, scorched copper-brass material, clipped pointed nose and trailing hot sparks. Column 2 alternate brass slug with changed spin highlights and spark tail. Column 3 small shrapnel impact, fractured brass chunks, sharp yellow sparks and a dark smoke tuft. Column 4 spreading dissipating shrapnel cloud with detached brass shards, short fading sparks and scattered smoke wisps.
Constraints: Exactly six rows in that order and exactly four columns. No extra objects. No character, weapon wielder, environment, ground, shadow plane, text, watermark, border, background color, checkerboard pattern, captions or symbols outside the subjects. All sprites isolated on true transparent pixels. Respect the 4 by 6 regular atlas cell layout. Keep all sprites broad-gap separated and safely within their cells. Original art only.

nora-salvage-coordinator-v551.prompt.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Original transparent full-body NPC character sprite for the painted 2.5D action RPG Gouden Horizon.
Primary request: Nora, an adult female salvage coordinator in a safe post-apocalyptic transport hub, viewed at a three-quarter FRONT angle, complete figure from head to both boot soles. She wears a practical teal utility coat with sturdy pockets and repaired seams, an amber scarf, modest work trousers, and worn brown leather boots. She holds a compact repaired electrical coil assembly in one hand near waist level and a small folded expedition map in the other. The coil is a believable salvaged copper winding on a compact iron bracket with a few neat repair bindings; it is neither a weapon nor a glowing magic orb. Folded map has muted paper creases and indistinct cartographic strokes, NO readable text.
Character: Calm approachable adult woman with an expressive readable face, practical swept-back brown hair with a few loose strands, capable understated demeanor. Grounded relaxed posture; torso upright, arms comfortably bent, hips centered above planted feet, both boots under hips and both boot soles clearly visible. Head slightly turned toward the viewer. Functional clothing and expedition wear, no glamorous costume, no exaggerated proportions.
Style/medium: Premium stylized hand-painted modern post-apocalyptic fantasy action RPG character art with the approachable dimensional polish of Torchlight and Nine Parchments, wholly original character design. Rich painterly color, tangible cloth/leather/brass material, elegant large readable forms, warm contour highlights, soft volumetric shading, clear silhouette and moderately stylized adult proportions. No pixel art, no vector flatness, no photorealism, no anime, no excessive microdetail.
Composition/framing: Single isolated full-body figure centered on a portrait canvas, generous fully transparent padding of at least 10% around all edges. Both feet near the lower center, with a flat, stable foot anchor; nothing cropped. Camera slightly elevated three-quarter-front action RPG view, not a strict profile or back view. Teal coat and amber scarf visibly separate; hands and carried items readable. No duplicated limbs, no detached objects.
Background: Genuinely transparent RGBA background. Transparent pixels all around the entire silhouette and between limbs, no rendered checkerboard.
Lighting: Warm clean rim highlights with softly shaded volume, natural calm palette, no colored aura.
Constraints: Nora only, no text, labels, numbers, watermark, frame, scenery, floor, ground plane, shadows cast on ground, environment, foreground objects, ground props, other characters, magical circle or background color. Preserve an isolated clean transparent silhouette with generous padding, whole body and both boots. Original art only.

processing: Crop, resize and WebP conversion only; no painted pixel edits.
